message.content:

**Analysis:**
- OpenAI is critically low at $78 cash with mostly mortgaged properties
- Gemini has strong dark blue hotels but I have a complete monopoly ready for development
- No beneficial trades exist right now (OpenAI has little to offer, Gemini is well-positioned)
- Mortgaging my Pink properties would destroy my winning engine—this is not an option
- My strategy requires advancing to my next **main turn** where I can roll dice and immediately build 4-5 houses on Pink to generate exponential rent pressure

The optimal move is to **end my post-turn actions** and proceed to my next main turn, where the execution phase begins.

Ending my turn is the optimal play. Mortgaging would sabotage my winning position, and trading offers no real benefit. I'll keep my public message neutral to avoid telegraphing my building intentions.
